name: Ousanas
contribution: The ruler of the Kingdom of Aksum in the 320s AD.

checks.lead: Ousanas (fl. 320), known as Ella Allada or Ella Amida in Eritrean and Ethiopian tradition, was the ruler of the Kingdom of Aksum in the 320s AD.
